description: Human-labelled claim-evidence cases for GDPR training grounding evaluation.

cases.claim: Article 5 identifies the requirement to limit personal data to what is necessary as data minimisation.
cases.supporting_quote: adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed (‘data minimisation’)
cases.label_reason: The quote explicitly states both the necessity limitation and the name data minimisation.

cases.claim: Collecting as much personal data as might become useful later conflicts with data minimisation.
cases.supporting_quote: adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed (‘data minimisation’)
cases.label_reason: Collecting data beyond what is necessary directly conflicts with the limitation stated in the quote.

cases.claim: A controller must report every data minimisation violation to the authority within 24 hours.
cases.supporting_quote: adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary in relation to the purposes for which they are processed (‘data minimisation’)
cases.label_reason: The quote contains no reporting obligation, authority notification requirement, or 24-hour deadline.
